body_markdown:
Step into the world of *[The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/the-hunger-games-x-scentbird-sunrise-on-the-reaping-197836082957097)* with Scentbird, Drift and DIFF Eyewear. Three lucky winners will each receive an exclusive prize package featuring limited-edition fragrances, home and car scents, and eyewear inspired by the film. Read the official giveaway rules below for details on how to enter and win.


## Giveaway Period


The giveaway begins November 18, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. ET and ends November 24, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET.


## How to Enter


During the giveaway period, entrants must complete the following steps on Instagram:


1. Follow[@scentbird](https://www.instagram.com/scentbird) ,[@driftgoods](https://www.instagram.com/driftgoods) and[@diffeyewear](https://www.instagram.com/diffeyewear) .
2. Like the official giveaway post.
3. Comment which prize you’re most excited about.
4. Tag a friend in the comments. Each friend tagged counts as one entry, provided all other entry requirements have been completed.


For one additional entry, share the giveaway post to your Instagram Stories during the giveaway period. Story shares must be viewable and verifiable to qualify for the additional entry.


No purchase necessary. A purchase will not increase your chances of winning.


## Eligibility


Entrants must be 18 years of age or older and legal residents of the United States. Entries must be received during the giveaway period and must be viewable and verifiable at the time of winner selection.


Void where prohibited.


## Winner Selection


Three (3) winners will be randomly selected from all eligible entries received and verified after the giveaway period ends. Each winner will receive one prize package as described below. The odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received.


## Prizes


Each winner will receive one prize package containing:


**The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Scentbird Eau de Parfum Collection**


- One (1) 20ml Eau de Parfum
- Two (2) 8ml travel sprays
- Two (2) fragrance cases
- One (1) limited-edition sticker sheet


**The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping x Drift Collection**


- One (1) Home Scent Diffuser Gift Set
- One (1) Wood Car Freshener Gift Set


**DIFF Eyewear**


- One (1) frame of the winner’s choice from the DIFF Eyewear The Hunger Games collection


The approximate retail value (ARV) is $327.80 per prize package, with a total ARV of $983.40 across all three prize packages.


## Winner Notification


Potential winners will be contacted via direct message only from @scentbird, @driftgoods or @diffeyewear.


Scentbird, Drift and DIFF Eyewear will never ask you to send money, make a purchase, provide payment information or pay a fee to claim a prize. Do not respond to messages from any other account claiming to represent these brands in connection with this giveaway.


Potential winners may be required to confirm eligibility and provide information reasonably necessary to fulfill the prize, including a U.S. shipping address.


Potential winners must respond within 24 hours of initial notification. Failure to respond within 24 hours will result in forfeiture of the prize, and an alternate winner may be selected. Potential winners may also forfeit the prize if they cannot be verified or are otherwise ineligible.


## Additional Terms


Entries must comply with all entry requirements outlined above and Instagram’s applicable terms and community guidelines. Entries that are incomplete, cannot be viewed or verified, or otherwise do not comply with these giveaway requirements may be disqualified.


By participating in this promotion and submitting an entry, all entrants agree to (i) be bound by these terms, including all entry requirements, and (ii) waive any and all claims against Scentbird, Drift and DIFF Eyewear (collectively, “Sponsors”), Lions Gate Entertainment Inc., and each of their respective parents, affiliated companies, subsidiaries, licensees, distributors, dealers, retailers, printers and advertising and promotion agencies (collectively, “Released Parties”) for any injury, damage or loss of any kind (including, but not limited to, personal injury, death, or damage to or loss of property) that may occur, directly or indirectly, in whole or in part, from participation in the promotion, or any promotion-related activity, or from the acceptance, receipt, possession and/or use or misuse of any prize.


This promotion is not sponsored, endorsed, administered by, or associated with Lions Gate Entertainment Inc. or Instagram.
